segments.text: Five size facts that sound fake. Number five is the strangest.
One. Africa is bigger than the USA, China and India combined. And there is still room left.
Two. On most maps, Greenland looks as big as Africa. In real life, Africa is fourteen times bigger.
Three. Australia is wider than the Moon. About four thousand kilometers, versus three thousand four hundred seventy five.
Four. Everest is not the tallest mountain. Measured from its base on the sea floor, Mauna Kea is over ten thousand meters.
Five. Alaska is the most northern, the most western, and the most eastern state in the USA.
Which one did you not believe? Tell me in the comments.
